system.description:
A Brewer is a specialized miller who grinds grain to ferment into alcohol. Obviously, this practice requires a mill (or at least some ground grain) and a vat, if not an actual brewery.

Obstacles: Peasant brew, Ob 1. Priest’s brew, Ob 2. Merchant’s brew, Ob 3. Nobles’ brew, Ob 4. Amount: for home, no penalty; for a small hostel, +1 Ob; for a tavern or pub, +2 Ob; for a brewery, +3 Ob.

FoRKs: Miller

Skill Type: Craftsman. Tools: Workshop

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 262
